title: The Bourne Identity
author: Robert Ludlum
summary: A man is pulled half-dead from the Mediterranean with no memory of who he is, only fragments of skill and a number on his body. Hunted by assassins, he tries to reconstruct his identity before he is killed.
readIf: you like dense, twisting espionage with a hero who is as puzzled as anyone about what he can do.
skipIf: you want the film's tight pacing; the novel is longer, more intricate and more old-fashioned.

pairings.reason: Another meticulous, hard-edged thriller about a professional killer and the people trying to stop him.
A slower, much more cerebral spy novel that treats espionage as patient detective work.
The classic spy hero in a shorter, more stylish and glamorous adventure.
